committee.sub: Morning brief · Friday 20 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: The A$600 credit is fully drawn (creditRemainingExGst at $0) against spendExGst of $754.48, and the Kontrol Search National campaign now sits PAUSED with spendLast7 at $0 versus $141.60 the week before.

Raw paid clicks on the landing page test reached 108, well past the 75-click checkpoint, with review_cta_click still at 0 since the test started on 6 Oct, meaning no booked review has been logged against the rule.

generate_lead has fired 3 times since the test started but 0 in the last 7 days (down from 2 the week before); these remain unverified enquiries that still need grading against the real business, repeatable process and named system rule.

Organic Search is the only trustworthy unpaid signal and it fell to 5 sessions from 14, while Paid Search dropped to 1 from 19 and AI Assistant sessions stayed at 0; search impressions8d sat at 280 with just 7 clicks through 17 Nov, and top queries like "business automation for tradies" and "simpro integration" sit at positions 58 and 65.

actions.text: Credit is exhausted and the campaign has paused itself; confirm this matches the decision rule since review_cta_click is 0, meaning no qualified prospect has booked and the pause should stand until that changes.
With raw clicks at 108, the page stays frozen past click 25; check the test log now to see whether qualified enquiries are still at zero, which would make the 75-click red flag active.
Three generate_lead events have fired since the test started; pull the Formspree and Cal.com emails to check source attribution on each and log them against the qualified rule in the test log.
Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups are still outstanding.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success and need updating to current site stats.

weekly: 108 raw clicks logged since 6 Oct, spend at $754.48 ex GST against the A$600 credit, and the campaign has now paused.
17 sessions versus 63 the week before, a 73% drop, with Thu 19 at 3 sessions against 7 on the same weekday last week (Thu 12).
generate_lead has fired 3 times since the test started but none in the last 7 days (down from 2 the prior week), and these remain unverified enquiries for Chris to grade.
1 session this week versus 19 prior, while Organic Search held the only trustworthy unpaid signal at 5 versus 14, and AI Assistant traffic stayed at 0.

280 impressions and 7 clicks over the 8 days through 17 Nov (lagged by about two days), with queries like "business automation for tradies" and "simpro integration" still sitting at positions 58 and 65.
